easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
